info.name: 16. Trip Payments
info.description:
Trip payment management endpoints.

## Access Control
- Create/Update/Delete: Owner, General Manager only
- View (List/Get): All roles (financial amounts hidden for Manager/Supervisor)

## Payment Types
- advance: Advance/booking payment
- partial: Partial payment
- final: Final settlement
- refund: Refund to customer

## Payment Modes
- cash
- upi
- bank_transfer
- card
- credit
- other

## Payment Status
- received: Payment confirmed
- pending: Awaiting confirmation
- cancelled: Payment cancelled

## Enhanced Response Fields
- vehicle_registration_number
- customer_contact
- trip_scheduled_date, trip_start_time
- trip_delivery_date, trip_delivery_time
